summary: Backend-only testing of the new admin + personal stats endpoints on Ghid Părinte (FastAPI). Added /app/backend/tests/test_admin_stats.py with 23 pytest tests covering: GET /api/me/stats (auth-gated + shape), super-admin flagging (auto-set is_admin on register/login for otilia.ioana96@gmail.com, idempotent on repeat login even when pre-existing user had is_admin=None), 403 gating on all /api/admin/* endpoints for non-admin users, /api/admin/stats shape (users/journal/ask_ai/tests+profile_distribution/families_total/forum+flagged_posts), /api/admin/users list with counts and search-by-email/name (case-insensitive), DELETE /api/admin/users/{id} cascade (verified journal + bookmarks + ask_history + forum_posts + forum_answers + families cleanup + login-fails-after-delete), DELETE-self returns 400, POST /api/admin/users/{id}/toggle-admin flip flow (super-admin cannot be modified → 400, missing user → 404), /api/admin/forum/flagged listing, full flag-then-delete moderation flow verifying answer_count decrement and post 404 after delete. ALL 23 admin/stats tests PASS. Full-suite regression: 39/40 pass; 1 pre-existing flaky test (TestArticle::test_article_generation_and_cache asserts elapsed2 < elapsed1 but both hits are ~0.13s cached from prior runs — not related to this feature).

minor.issue: `total` uses count_documents(query) so it correctly reflects the filtered result set, but each returned user runs 4 additional queries (journal_count, ask_count, forum_count, last_activity). For large user lists this is N+1. Consider an aggregation pipeline. Non-blocking.
active_last_7_days streams full journal+ask_history docs into a Python set (async for). For a busy app this can be memory-heavy. Consider distinct() with a date filter.

ask_history dates are compared via since_7.isoformat() string — relies on all ask_history rows using isoformat strings. Journal uses datetime. Mixed date storage across collections is a latent bug source but currently works.

action_items: None required for the admin+stats feature — all specified behaviours are implemented correctly and covered by tests.
Optional: replace the N+1 pattern in /api/admin/users with a single Mongo aggregation ($lookup) once user count grows.
Optional: normalise created_at storage between collections (journal uses datetime, ask_history uses isoformat strings) to avoid future dashboarding bugs.

Unrelated pre-existing flaky test: TestArticle::test_article_generation_and_cache in backend_test.py; both first and second call now hit the same cache, causing an intermittent assert failure — main agent may want to relax the timing assertion.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1248 lines — well past the 700-line threshold. Recommend splitting into routers/{auth,forum,admin,journal,article,family,guide}.py.
SUPER_ADMIN_EMAIL is hard-coded in server.py (line 285). Consider moving to backend/.env (e.g. SUPER_ADMIN_EMAIL=...) so different environments can be configured without code changes.

require_admin correctly accepts either explicit is_admin=True OR the super-admin email — idempotent flag-set on login is implemented at /auth/login (line 327). This handles pre-existing users seeded without the flag as required.

Cascade delete in /admin/users/{id} covers: users, journal, bookmarks, ask_history, test_results, forum_posts, forum_answers, guide_progress, families ($pull member + delete empty families). Coverage is complete.
toggle-admin correctly blocks modifying the super admin (checks email, not just is_admin flag).

success_rate.backend: 100% (23/23 admin+stats); 97.5% (39/40) overall — 1 pre-existing flaky test unrelated to this feature
success_rate.frontend: n/a — backend-only testing per review request
